name: english-sentence-builder-apk
description: Android İngilizce Kelime, Gramer ve SVOMPT Cümle Kurma Programı

scripts.copy-web: mkdir -p www && cp -r assets css js data index.html manifest.json sw.js www/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "İngilizce Cümle Fabrikası" com.alionur.englishapp --web-dir www
scripts.cap:open: npm run sync && npx cap open android
